plan.P1_inputs: Original price file quant-tf/.cache/quant_trials/sp500_close.parquet (yfinance, 2009-01-02..2025-12-31), membership quant-tf/data/raw/stocks/sp500_membership.csv, as in sp500_test.build. plan.P2_missing_set: Names with point-in-time-eligible Thursdays 2020-2025 and no y5 target in the original build (coordinator: 79 names, 11,589 of 152,654 name-weeks). Recomputed and asserted.
plan.P3_fill_rule: Per missing name: Alpaca closes (broad chunks; y2026 chunks chain-linked onto broad on their first common session, scale = broad/y26, returns corr > 0.999 on the overlap else flag) are written only into panel cells that are NaN on yfinance sessions (never overwrite a yfinance close), only for sessions <= min(2025-12-31, last eligible session + 10 sessions) (so a later re-use of the ticker by another security is not read). Where yfinance has closes for the name on overlapping sessions: daily-return correlation > 0.999 required, else the name is flagged and NOT filled (typed defect). Content contract per filled name: sessions on the yfinance calendar only, no gap > 5 sessions inside the filled span, positive closes, last bar within 10 sessions of the last eligible session or a stated reason. Source check: Alpaca vs yfinance daily-return correlation 2016-2025 on all panel names present in both (quantiles reported).
plan.P4_rebuild: A copy of sp500_test.build that takes a price frame (code identical otherwise). Assert ORIG copy == T.build() exactly (every array). REPAIRED = same copy on the repaired prices. Per-name fields (r, beta, e, valid, elig, raw signals) asserted array_equal for names not filled. Cross-sectionally standardised / demeaned fields (Z, y5/y10/y20, frozen) cannot be identical (the filled names enter each session's mean and std): reported as max abs diff and rank-corr, not asserted. Coverage against expected: filled name-weeks with finite y5 and finite MASTER input (8 rows of Z) vs the missing set; per-name table.
plan.P5_fit: research/tree/L4_arch/arch.py fit(d, 'base', seed, year, Thursdays of year, ckpt) (= quant-tf master_fit_predict with checkpoints; as-run cfg d_model 256, beta 5; windows(S, year, 5); lr 1e-5; stop loss<0.95 or patience 15; max 100 epochs), imported read-only. 60 fits: arms ORIG, REPAIRED x years 2020-2025 x seeds 0-4. Scores = mean over seeds. 4 workers, nice 10, nohup, no time-of-day pause, stop below 4 GB free disk; checkpoints deleted after prediction. Predictions .cache/tree/r3/pred_<arm>_y<year>_s<seed>.npz.
plan.P6_fidelity: ORIG retrain vs saved quant-tf sp500_tf_master_h5.npz (h5): weekly Spearman of scores (mean, min), IC of each and their difference, corr of weekly ICs.
plan.P7_report: Paired ORIG vs REPAIRED (each scored on its own panel; also both on the REPAIRED panel's y5 and returns): weekly IC 2020-2025 (harness.weekly_ic on y5, Thursdays with target window inside the year, NW t 4 lags) and by year; MASTER decile book gross 0.6 beta-hedged 5 bp (L4_exploit/run.py sim + book_decile, K.GROSS_SIDE 0.3, rf dtb3): book %/yr arith, book Sharpe, by year; whole fund B0 (trend core 1.3/0.7 on 200-session mean + book): %/yr compounded, Sharpe, by year; paired diff with NW t; count of repaired names held (name-weeks, distinct names, share of book gross) and their contribution to book return (sum w*R over repaired names, %/yr). Saved-h5 B0 on ORIG panel reproduces 21.69 %/yr, Sharpe 0.937 as a sim check. Every number labelled 'reused 2020-2025 window; survivorship bound'.
deviations_stated_upfront: Z and y are cross-sectional (standardised / demeaned per session over eligible names): identical-for-unrepaired names is asserted on per-name fields only.
